To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the precision of dances performed by A florea, A dorsata and A mellifera for sources nearby is highly variable.
the dance precision of all three species increases with increasing distance to the goal, and that the size of patch advertised by the dance increases with increasing distance.

all honeybees improve dance precision with increased distance and dance duration, irrespective if the dance is performed on a vertical or horizontal surface, using the sun or gravity as point of references, or for foraging and swarms, with the exception of dances performed by A.mellifera on swarming.

the dance of all species of Apis is imprecise when advertising a source nearby.

dance precision is affected by distance to the goal and dance duration, irrespective the species and point of reference, but that the dance of A. melliféra on swarms differs from the other species.
